description: This file defines the EmployeePictureController class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages employee picture retrieval, either from the database through EmployeePictureService or by defaulting to a static image. The controller handles HTTP requests, sets appropriate headers, and responds with the employee's picture or a default image.

classes.name: EmployeePictureController
classes.description: Controller for handling employee picture retrieval requests, extends AbstractFileController to leverage common file response handling functionalities.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmployeePictureService.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request to retrieve and respond with an employee's picture or a default image if not available.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets standard HTTP headers for image responses to control caching and content type.
